license_note: The full license text sits both beside the weights and in the MiniMax-M2.7 GitHub repository. It permits non-commercial use on MIT-style terms but prohibits any commercial use without separate prior written authorization from MiniMax, and additionally requires commercial deployments to display 'Built with MiniMax M2.7' — with no revenue or user threshold — so the release is source-available under terms stricter than M2's.

license_evidence.scope: MiniMax-M2.7 model weights, repository code, and derivative works, beside the weights and in the GitHub repository

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7 weight release at Hugging Face commit d494266a4affc0d2995ba1fa35c8481cbd84294b (last modified 2026-04-20). The MiniMax-M2.5 predecessor, the M3 generation, the M2.7-highspeed endpoint tier, the platform API, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: 130 Safetensors shards with the full license text beside the weights and in-repository SGLang, vLLM, and Transformers deployment guides
The Open Platform lists MiniMax-M2.7 as a served model at 204,800 context
tradeoffs: Any commercial use requires separate prior written authorization, the strictest commercial posture in the M2 line
No changelog or retirement posture accompanies the release, and the platform lists a same-performance highspeed tier beside the line that carries no release identity of its own
